title: Staff Development RN
description:
Amberwoods of Farmington looking for an experienced Staff Development Coordinator to join our team!

20 Hours Flexible Schedule

We value our employees and support job enthusiasm and positive relationships.

We offer Competitive wages and an excellent benefit package which includes:

· Paid time off

· 401 k

Amberwoods is a 130-bed newly renovated, progressive facility providing long-term skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation and Memory Care services, located in Farmington, CT. Our facility is conveniently located within proximity to I-84 and is a ten-minute drive to downtown Hartford.

The role of the Director of Staff Development is critical to the success of our employees. This is an exciting opportunity for a candidate with the ability to engage and inspire our employees to excel in providing safe and effective quality care. Candidate must be a licensed Registered Nurse in the State of Connecticut with previous experience in the provision of educational guidance and clinical support in a health care setting.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct general orientation and mandatory in-service programs in accordance with regulatory requirements
  • Provide continuing education to help employees identify strategies that can improve critical thinking, interpersonal and technical skills
  • Perform competency skills to assess safety training in the workplace
  • Evaluate competencies and determine what training, support and resources are necessary for individual success
  • Determine and assess facility educational needs
  • Evaluate and monitor transition from orientation to ensure quality resident care in conjunction with the facility’s philosophy and core objectives
  • Assist and coach employees through knowledge, skill and encouragement
  • Apply strategies and teaching modules that foster critical thinking and facilitate a team approach to resident care
  • Communicate areas of concern with the Administrator/DNS
  • Create optimal employee relations necessary to motivate, recruit and maintain staff retention levels

Qualifications

  • Current State of Connecticut Registered Nurse License
  • Proficient knowledge of CMS and state regulations in order to promote best practices in education and training
  • 2 years of clinical managerial nursing experience
  • Ability to effectively communicate with nursing personnel in a health care setting
  • Excellent computer skills, including experience with EMR's
  • Highly effective as a team leader and motivator
  • Detail-oriented with solid organizational skills
  • Ability to work flexible hours, when necessary
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both a diverse clientele and workforce through sound business decisions, diplomacy and discretion

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability, gender, gender identity, marital status, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation or veteran status.

Medical Specialty:

  • Geriatrics

Physical Setting:

  • Long term care

Schedule:

  • Flexible schedule to accommodate all staff

Amberwoods is currently looking for qualified Licensed Practical Nurses (LPN) to join our team. We are looking for caring and compassionate candidates to provide our residents and their families with the superior care delivered by our staff dedicated to the principles of kindness, compassion, customer service and excellence.

Amberwoods is a 130-bed facility providing long-term skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation and Memory Care services, located in Farmington, CT. Our facility is conveniently located within proximity to I-84 and is a ten-minute drive to downtown Hartford..

Requirements:

  • Current Connecticut Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license

  • Prior long term care experience preferred

Licensed Practical Nurse Responsibilities:

  • LPN plans and manages patient care according to each patient’s needs.

  • LPN interviews patients and records their medical history and physical condition.

  • LPN obtains patient vital signs, including pulse, blood pressure, temperature, and respiration.

  • LPN provides routine care for patients.

  • LPN observes patients’ health.

  • LPN reviews medical charts.

  • LPN accompanies patients to their rooms.

  • LPN assists physicians and registered nurses.

  • LPN communicates with patients and their families.

  • LPN prepares specimens for lab courier.

  • LPN administers medications.

  • LPN provides wound care.

  • LPN prepares and administers injections and/or enemas.

  • LPN assists with patient comfort.

  • LPN monitors catheters.

title: RN Supervisor 3-11 M-F
description:
We are seeking a Registered Nurse Supervisor's to join our team: 

Monday to Friday 40 hr position. 

Hourly pay: up to $55 per hour but we pay for lunch.  With paid lunch the rate is equal to upo to $58.67 per hour.

Bonus: $5,000 sign-on bonus.

Amberwoods is a 130-bed facility providing long-term skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation and Memory Care services, located in Farmington, CT. Our facility is conveniently located within proximity to I-84 and is a ten-minute drive to downtown Hartford.

Please note we offer Competitive wages and an excellent benefit package which includes for full-time employees:

We commit to hiring enthusiastic, professional, and compassionate individuals who enjoy coming to work every day.

We value our employees and support job enthusiasm and positive relationships. Our company offers a competitive benefits package including 401(k) and comprehensive medical and dental.

The Registered Nurse Supervisor must have strong clinical and supervisory skills, as well as previous long term care experience.

The Registered Nurse Supervisor has strong attention to detail, a positive attitude, good follow through skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks are required.

The Registered Nurse Supervisor works as a team player with Nursing Staff to provide excellent clinical care and the Registered Nurse Supervisor must demonstrate a willingness to assist others.

RN Nursing Supervisor Responsibilities

· The RN Supervisor is accountable for the administrative, clinical, and professional development of facility personnel for the designated shift.

· The RN Supervisor coordinates, directs, and oversees all aspects of the delivery of nursing care.

· The RN Supervisor demonstrates competence in leadership and relevant clinical experience.

· The RN Supervisor collaborates with physicians and other health care professionals; complies with orders in a timely manner.

· The RN Supervisor conducts unit rounds, ensuring that clinical practices are delivered within the facility's established standards of care.

· The RN Supervisor maintains standards of care in accordance with regulatory agencies.

RN Supervisor Qualifications

· Current CT Registered Nurse License.

· RN must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· The RN Supervisor must have the ability to work as part of a team, while managing multiple tasks in a safe and effective manner.

· The RN Supervisor must be courteous and professional with an exceptional "bedside manner" have a high tolerance for working under pressure and handling critical situations

· The RN Supervisor must have the ability to effectively communicate with a diverse workforce and clientele through sound business decisions, diplomacy and discretion.

Our Company an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants, regardless of age, ancestry, color, disability, gender, gender identity, marital status, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation or veteran status.

title: Recreational Therapist
description:
Amberwoods of Farmington is currently welcoming applications for a Recreational or Music Therapist to join our team and help enrich quality of life for our residents. We are searching for a candidate who is energetic, outgoing, enthusiastic, creative, a team player, and has a talent for working with people with dementia. Must be able to assess, plan, execute and evaluate a full range of interventions with consideration of residents’ physical and cognitive abilities as well as individual preferences.

Job requirements:

  • Associates or Bachelor Degree in Therapeutic Recreation or Music Therapy, Certification Preferred
  • Experience in dementia care and/or long term care
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills
  • Work schedule includes weekends, evenings and holidays
